note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: New data centre, Alandale Scaffolding site, Langston Road, Loughton IG10 3SL (Epping Forest EPF/1165/22 and EPF/0388/26; condition application EPF/1785/26) - possibly Nscale's Loughton AI campus
entries.reason: Epping Forest District Council's weekly list of applications registered in the week up to 25 September 2026 (local efdc/Weekly-List-25-09-2026.xlsx, sha256 in its metadata) lists EPF/1785/26, 'Approval of Details Reserved by Condition 4 (Contaminated Land) of EPF/1165/22 & EPF/0388/26 (New Data Centre)', at Alandale Scaffolding, Langston Road, Loughton IG10 3SL. That dated council record names a data-centre development and could support announced status, and it implies two data-centre permissions, but their decision dates and approved scope were not read, so permitted is not supported. No official locator was found: the list gives only the address and postcode; the council's Salesforce register page is JavaScript-rendered (its Aura POST API was not used), rds.eppingforestdc.gov.uk returns a 403 robots file, there is no Environment Agency permit for Nscale or Langston Road, and a postcode centroid is not an acceptable locator. Nscale's AI-infrastructure page names a 'London-proximate AI campus' at Loughton (up to 90 MW) but gives no address, so the tie to Langston Road is not established.
entries.reopen_condition: An official site point or boundary for EPF/1165/22 or EPF/0388/26 (application form grid reference, red-line plan or Environment Agency permit) and, for permitted status, the decision notice of EPF/0388/26 with date and approved works; for the Nscale identity, an Nscale or council record naming the Langston Road site.

entries.candidate: VIRTUS LONDON14 data centre (DC6), Unit D, Plot C, Prologis Park Heathrow, Stockley Road, West Drayton (EA permit EPR/UP3624SW; Hillingdon 18399/APP/2022/411)
entries.reason: Re-check of the uk-planning-portals-p3 hold with Environment Agency evidence. The Environment Agency's compliance assessment report UP3624SW/0604835 (local ea-car/EPR-UP3624SW_SI_0604835_20260806.pdf) records a liaison meeting and site inspection, dated 6 August 2026, at 'LONDON14 Datacentre' (VIRTUS Holdco Limited) covering the stacks and the single engine unit, with no breaches, and discusses climate-risk assessment of 'standby engine operations'. It shows the permitted standby plant is installed, but it states neither construction, completion nor operation of the data centre, so no physical status can be selected; the EA register point (TQ0804579594; 51.504956, -0.44466) is a ready locator.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) Virtus, Environment Agency or Hillingdon record stating that LONDON14 is under construction, complete or operating; then admit it with the EPR/UP3624SW register point.

entries.candidate: Amazon Didcot Data Centre (existing facility on the former Didcot A power station site, EA permit EPR/LP3005BL), 630 m from the Atlas AWS Didcot North campus locator
entries.reason: The Environment Agency's compliance assessment report LP3005BL/0606755 (local ea-car/EPR-LP3005BL_SI_0606755_20260909.pdf) records an incident inspection on 7 September 2026 after a diesel spill of about 15,000-20,000 litres on 2 September 2026 'during routine testing of generator 1.2A' at the 'Amazon Didcot Datacentre', with remediation ongoing and ten actions set. Routine testing of installed standby generators implies an operating data centre, but the report never states that the data centre operates, and the facility's relation to the Atlas 'AWS Didcot North Data Centre Campus (DCA-DCD)' record (announced, locator 630 m north-east at the Didcot North permit point) needs a separate identity review: it is a different permit (registered October 2021) and probably a separate, older building group on the same former power-station land.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) Amazon, Environment Agency or Vale of White Horse record that explicitly says the existing Didcot data centre operates, plus a decision whether it is a separate site (EPR/LP3005BL register point SU5089091490, 51.619934, -1.266325) or a project on the Didcot North campus.

entries.candidate: Virtus Stockley Park campus (LONDON5-8, Horton Road, EPR/AP3903PD) and Virtus LON2, Western International Park, Hayes (EPR/EP3247JV)
entries.reason: Environment Agency compliance assessment reports AP3903PD/0604832 and EP3247JV/0604820 (issued 6 August 2026) record liaison meetings and site inspections on 3 August 2026 (LON7.5 engine, SCR and stacks; LON2 stacks, drains and engine room B), with no breaches. The inspection date is exactly 85 days before 27 October 2026 and falls outside the window on any later publication day, and neither report states that the data centres operate. Neither campus is in the Atlas.
entries.reopen_condition: A newer dated (within 85 days) Virtus or regulator statement of operation or construction for LON5-8 or LON2; the EA register points are ready locators.

entries.candidate: Equinix Slough campus (LD4-LD7, EPR/LP3303PR), LD11x (EPR/CP3409BH) and LD13x (EPR/LP3205LW), Slough Trading Estate
entries.reason: Three Environment Agency compliance reports dated 11 August 2026 are desk reviews of generator emission monitoring plans (a ten-year rolling programme; 121 generators across the three Slough permits). They are regulatory data reviews, not physical observations, and none states that the data centres operate. None of these Equinix sites is in the Atlas.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) Equinix or Environment Agency site-inspection record stating the data centres operate; the EA register points are ready locators.

entries.candidate: Redhill Data Centre, Units 2 and 3, St Anne's Boulevard, Redhill (Redhill Data Centre Limited; EPR/JP3929SJ)
entries.reason: The Environment Agency report JP3929SJ/0605908 issued 10 September 2026 is a desktop review of an improvement-condition submission received on 14 May 2026 (interceptor and fire-water details; a minor C3 breach). It is not a physical observation and its assessed submission predates the window.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) operator or regulator statement of the site's operation or of the consented new 15 MW building's construction.

entries.candidate: Barclays Gloucester Data Centre, Barnett Way, Barnwood, Gloucester (Barclays Execution Services Limited; EPR/LP3426SK)
entries.reason: The Environment Agency report LP3426SK/0605185 records a visit on 4 August 2026 to observe emissions testing of the site's back-up generators and the decommissioning of generators in Blocks A and B. This is a bank's in-house enterprise data centre, outside the commercial-data-centre priority, so it is set aside.
entries.reopen_condition: Only if the Atlas scope is widened to enterprise data centres.

entries.candidate: Registers and feeds swept on 27 October 2026 without further admissible records (England)
entries.reason: GOV.UK search API: 'data centre', 'datacentre', 'data center', 'data hall', 'section 35', recovered and called-in decisions and AI Growth Zone items since 3 August 2026, plus all 546 Environment Agency, 451 MHCLG and 84 Planning Inspectorate items in the window: the only data-centre items are the AWS Didcot permit (3 August, already reflected in the Atlas) and the AWS Iver advertisement (13 August, the Atlas Ridgeway record); the Tritax Symmetry Biggleswade and London Gateway adverts are sewage-discharge permits. Planning Inspectorate Casework Database (22 October 2026 release): no appellant, address or reference identifies a data-centre appeal decided in the window (Greystoke's Waterstock and Chelmsford appeals were dismissed in December 2025 and July 2026). Environment Agency installations register: all 5,180 registrations read; no new data-centre registration from 22 to 27 October; compliance documents listed for 85 data-centre-related permits, of which the in-window site inspections are used or held above. Public Notice Portal: the active-notices sitemap's newest planning notice is from 24 October 00:14 UTC, already swept by earlier lanes. London Planning Datahub: the 585 data-centre records re-queried; in-window decisions are those already in the Atlas or earlier holds. South Norfolk's weekly lists for the weeks ending 2 to 23 October 2026 and Epping Forest's lists for 11 and 25 September and 2 to 23 October 2026 contain no other data-centre application. North Lincolnshire's site returned a reCAPTCHA bot-verification page (stopped, no bypass) and Stockport's robots file disallows ClaudeBot, so Elsham and Kao Data Manchester could not be checked.
entries.reopen_condition: Repeat these sweeps in the next update window; read the compliance-document lists of data-centre installation permits for new site-inspection reports.
